from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,textwrap
task=Path("reports/T0007")
freeze=json.loads((task/"review-r2-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
docs=["README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","reports/T0007/review-r2/review.md"]
for p,h in freeze["input_sha256"].items():
    if p not in docs:assert sha(p)==h,p
for p,h in freeze["history_sha256"].items():assert sha(p)==h,p
supp=freeze["supplement"]
assert sha(supp["copied_to"])==supp["sha256"]
links=blocks=0
for name in docs+["reports/T0007/pi-r2-focused/provenance.md"]:
    p=Path(name);s=p.read_text()
    assert s.endswith("\n") and all(line==line.rstrip() for line in s.splitlines()),name
    for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",s):
        target=target.strip("<>").split("#",1)[0]
        if target and not re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z]+:",target):
            assert (p.parent/target).exists(),(name,target)
            links+=1
    for i,code in enumerate(re.findall(chr(96)*3+r"python\n(.*?)"+chr(96)*3,s,re.S)):
        compile(textwrap.dedent(code),f"{name}:{i}","exec");blocks+=1
handoff=Path(docs[2]).read_text()
assert "- 状态："+chr(96)+"accepted"+chr(96) in handoff
assert all(f"- [x] A{i}：" in handoff for i in range(1,8))
check=subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert check.returncode==0,check.stdout+check.stderr
runs={}
for name in ("review-r2-freeze","review-r2-focused","review-r2-probes"):
    d=task/name;rec=json.loads((d/"record.json").read_text())
    assert rec["status"]=="finished" and rec["exit_code"]==0
    assert rec["before"]["source_sha256"]==rec["after"]["source_sha256"]
    for p,h in rec["after"]["source_sha256"].items():assert sha(p)==h,p
    for stream in ("stdout","stderr"):assert sha(d/(stream+".txt"))==rec[stream+"_sha256"]
    runs[name]={k:rec[k] for k in ("argv","exit_code","elapsed_s","started_at_utc","finished_at_utc")}
assert "44 passed in 0.11s" in (task/"review-r2-focused/stdout.txt").read_text()
assert not (task/"review-r2-focused/stderr.txt").read_bytes()
artifacts=docs+["reports/T0007/review-r2/probe.py","reports/T0007/review-r2-probes/findings.json","reports/T0007/review-r2-freeze/audit.json",supp["copied_to"]]
audit={
"created_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
"result":"PASS","task_status":"accepted","head":freeze["head"],
"reviewer":"Codex + gpt-6-astra xhigh (non-author of Pi implementation)",
"accepted_files":{p:sha(p) for p in ("src/kmesh/logic/dependency.py","tests/test_dependency.py")},
"product_defect_found":False,"open_findings":[],
"closed_findings":["R1 generator reason/type assertions","R2 record corrections with disclosed historical limits"],
"acceptance":{f"A{i}":"PASS" for i in range(1,8)},
"A7_limits":"Current results independently reproducible. Missing historical attempts and self-reported move/reuse of RUN are not deemed full procedural compliance.",
"verification_runs":runs,"independent_tests_this_round":"44 passed in 0.11s; stderr empty; no skips/xfails",
"inherited_evidence":["review-r1-full: 482 passed in 4.30s","review-r1-probes: 512 directed three-vertex graphs (25 DAG, 487 cyclic)"],
"full_or_doctor_rerun_this_round":False,
"probe_results":json.loads((task/"review-r2-probes/findings.json").read_text()),
"pi_r2_runs_verified":len(freeze["pi_r2_records"]),
"historical_files_preserved":len(freeze["history_sha256"]),
"supplement":supp,
"closure_checks":{"git_diff_check":"PASS","strict_local_links_checked":links,"python_blocks_compiled":blocks,"text_hygiene":"PASS"},
"artifact_sha256":{p:sha(p) for p in artifacts},
"limits":["No product/test edit by Codex","Original invocation/environment for supplemental doctor JSON not archived; two further attempts unavailable","RUN rename/reuse is self-reported, not independently reconstructed","Given DAG check only, not full world audit or research result","No commit/push"]
}
with (task/"review-r2/final-audit.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump(audit,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write("\n")
print(f"PASS: frozen sources/tests, {len(freeze['history_sha256'])} historical files and copied supplement unchanged")
print(f"PASS: accepted status, diff, {links} strict local links, {blocks} Python blocks")
print("PASS: final-audit.json written; A1-A7 accepted with historical evidence limits")
